title: [202405][DNX] - `route/test_route_perf.py` fails with `l3_alpm_enable` missing from `config.bcm` files on DNX systems
author: arista-nwolfe
body:
### Issue Description

`route/test_route_perf.py` checks the soc property of the system via `conf show l3_alpm_enable`.
On DNX systems we don't include `l3_alpm_enable` in the soc properties (config.bcm) files therefore the test fails.

We confirmed with BRCM in CS00012377343 that `l3_alpm_enable` is specific to XGS systems

### Results you see

route/test_route_perf.py:100: AttributeError</error></testcase><testcase classname="route.test_route_perf" name="test_perf_add_remove_routes[6-cmp206-6-None]" file="route/test_route_perf.py" line="214" time="16.666"><properties><property name="start" value="2024-11-06 11:36:07.320016" /><property name="end" value="2024-11-06 11:36:23.996828" /></                properties><error message="failed on setup with "Failed: l3_alpm_enable is not set for route scaling"">duthosts = [<MultiAsicSonicHost cmp206-4>, <MultiAsicSonicHost cmp206-5>, <MultiAsicSonicHost cmp206-6>, <MultiAsicSonicHost cmp206>], enum_rand_one_per_hwsku_frontend_hostname = 'cmp206-6', tbinfo = {'auto_recover': True,     'comment': 'Tests Arista Arista-7804R3-FM', 'conf-name': 'ardut', 'duts': ['cmp206-4', 'cmp206-5', 'cmp206-6', 'cmp206'], ...}                
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              
    @pytest.fixture
    def check_config(duthosts, enum_rand_one_per_hwsku_frontend_hostname, tbinfo):
        if tbinfo["topo"]["type"] in ["m0", "mx"]:
            return

        duthost = duthosts[enum_rand_one_per_hwsku_frontend_hostname]
        asic = duthost.facts["asic_type"]
        asic_name = duthost.get_asic_name()
        if (asic == "broadcom" and asic_name not in ['th4', 'th5']):
            alpm_enable = duthost.command('bcmcmd "conf show l3_alpm_enable"')["stdout_lines"][2].strip()
            logger.info("Checking config: {}".format(alpm_enable))
>           pytest_assert(alpm_enable == "l3_alpm_enable=2", "l3_alpm_enable is not set for route scaling")
E           Failed: l3_alpm_enable is not set for route scaling

alpm_enable = 'drivshell>'
asic       = 'broadcom'
asic_name  = 'unknown'
duthost    = <MultiAsicSonicHost cmp206-6>
duthosts   = [<MultiAsicSonicHost cmp206-4>, <MultiAsicSonicHost cmp206-5>, <MultiAsicSonicHost cmp206-6>, <MultiAsicSonicHost cmp206>]
enum_rand_one_per_hwsku_frontend_hostname = 'cmp206-6'
tbinfo     = {'auto_recover': True, 'comment': 'Tests Arista Arista-7804R3-FM', 'conf-name': 'ardut', 'duts': ['cmp206-4', 'cmp206-5', 'cmp206-6', 'cmp206'], ...}

### Results you expected to see

Test should've skipped the soc property check

linkedPullRequests.title: Skip l3_alpm_enable check on broadcom-dnx platforms
linkedPullRequests.author: arista-nwolfe
linkedPullRequests.body:
### Description of PR
Broadcom confirmed that `l3_alpm_enable` soc property is only used in `XGS` platforms (CS00012377343)
Therefor we should skip the check for this soc property on `DNX` platforms.

Summary:
Fixes #15511
